_comment: Signature dishes for the 3D carousel. 'plate' selects the procedural placeholder 3D model; set 'model' to a .glb path (DRACO-compressed is fine) to use a real model instead.

dishes.name: Godavari Maharaja Thali
dishes.description: Our signature unlimited thali with seasonal sabzis, varan-bhaat, kadhi, chapati, jowar bhakri, koshimbir, papad and a sweet of the day.

dishes.name: Nashik Misal Pav
dishes.description: Fiery sprouted moth-bean usal crowned with crunchy farsan, onion and coriander, with soft pav and a wedge of lemon.

dishes.name: Puran Poli with Ghee
dishes.description: Hand-rolled flatbread stuffed with chana dal, jaggery, nutmeg and cardamom, served warm with pure ghee and katachi amti.

dishes.name: Paneer Tikka Platter
dishes.description: Tandoor-charred paneer, peppers and onion in a smoky hung-curd marinade with mint chutney.

dishes.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
dishes.description: Paper-thin golden dosa layered with red chutney and potato bhaji, with sambar and coconut chutney.

dishes.name: Mithai Platter
dishes.description: Ukadiche modak, gulab jamun, shrikhand and jalebi: a festive taste of every season.
